Name: A rotten constellation - Redux
Author: mistyspring
Description:
[size=3]Compatible with SVE. Remake of my old mod.

A short story involving junimos, the wizard, and... aliens?
This is a far constellation, taken over by descomposition and rotting debris. After a boom catches your attention, you meet a character pleading for your help. You must voyage between both realms- and destroy the source of this chaos.

If you're not sure how to advance:
[spoiler]
- Go to the Forest at any time of the day.
- Go to the SeedShop / Pierre's
- Go to Marnie's
- Go to the Saloon
After this you should be warped to the end destination immediately.
[/spoiler]
Once you've finished all events, two new zones will be unlocked.

Planned features:
- Heart events for the new NPC
- A new map zone
[/size]
